title: AWS releases AWS Emulator, a free tool that simulates 200+ of its services locally, saying AI agents wrote it and its team hasn't written or reviewed any code (Todd Bishop/GeekWire)
summary: Todd Bishop / GeekWire: AWS releases AWS Emulator, a free tool that simulates 200+ of its services locally, saying AI agents wrote it and its team hasn't written or reviewed any code — AWS says its engineers didn't write or review a single line of code in its newest developer tool, and the company is touting that as a selling point.
